entries.note: This is the last update for this app Orca for Android has moved to a new app, dev.orca.app . It's on Google Play , and as an APK on GitHub for phones without Play. This app ( com.stably.orca.mobile ) won't get any more updates after this one, including security fixes. The new app is separate, so it can't update this one in place. You need to install it once, and from then on it updates itself. What this update does When you open Orca, it shows you how to move to the new app. Its name on your home screen is now Orca (old) , so you can tell the two apart. Switching to the new app Install the new app from Google Play. If your phone doesn't have Play, download the APK from the new app's release . It installs next to this one. entries.title: Orca Mobile Android android-v0.0.65
entries.note: Orca for Android has moved to a new app This is the new Orca app for Android ( dev.orca.app ). It's the same build as the one on Google Play . If you installed Orca from GitHub, you need to install this APK. The old app ( com.stably.orca.mobile ) gets no more updates, including security fixes. This is a separate app, so it installs next to the old one instead of updating it. Future GitHub releases will update this app. If your phone has Google Play, install Orca from Play instead. Play keeps it up to date for you. Switching from the old app Install this APK. If your phone asks, allow your browser to install apps. Pair it: in Orca on your computer, go to Settings → Mobile and scan the code. Delete the old app once your agents show up in the new one. Faster session search, agents on your phone & smoother chat switching ✨ We shipped two releases in quick succession: 1.4.254 yesterday and 1.4.255 today. See the 1.4.254 release notes for Git Graph, chat forks, on-device phone dictation, more resilient mobile work, and pairing and trust improvements. A little less waiting, a little more flow. This update makes large session histories easier to search, brings your agents together on your phone, and smooths out the everyday work of switching accounts, models and workspaces. ⚡ Find past work without slowing down: Session History searches run off the app’s main thread, keep results visible while you type, and show your last list immediately after a restart while it refreshes. Git Graph, on-phone dictation & side questions in chat ✨ 🌳 See the whole repository: A new Git Graph tab shows local and remote branches and tags, with each commit's details and changed files. Folder workspaces now get Source Control, with a card for each attached repo, and the branch name in Source Control switches or creates a branch in place. 💬 Ask without derailing a chat: In Chat UI, /btw asks a side question in a fork beside the chat while the original keeps running, and /fork branches from the latest response.
